Status.description:
Where a task stands. A store's other states, such as deleted or waiting,
stay out of a listing.

Task.description: One task as a store lists it.

description.description: What the task says, on one line.

entry.description:
When the task was created. Compared as text, so it needs a format
that sorts by time, such as ISO 8601 in UTC.

id.description: What every edit addresses the task by. Stable for the task's life.

modified.description: When the task last changed, compared the same way as `entry`.

order.description:
Position among the task's siblings, lowest first. Tasks without one
follow the ordered ones, oldest first.

parent.description:
The `id` of the task this one nests under. A parent the listing does
not hold leaves the task at the top level.

project.description:
The project node the task belongs to, such as `repo.branch`. Absent
is the global list.

started.description: Work on the task has begun.

description: What `[integrations.tasks.command] list` prints: the store's pending and completed tasks, as one JSON array.
title: alacritree task list
